c06927.risk_area: Business Logic - Order State Machine Bypass
c06927.evidence: POST /api/Orders endpoint returns 500 errors. Could not validate whether order state transitions are enforced or whether workflow steps can be bypassed. Requires correct API contract format to test properly.

78fe19.evidence: GET /api/BasketItems/coupon returns 404, POST returns 500. Coupon endpoint structure unclear. OWASP Juice Shop is known to have discount-related vulnerabilities, but could not validate without proper API understanding. Known OWASP Juice Shop coupon codes (OWASP2017, etc.) were not testable due to API format issues.

864c88.evidence: Products endpoint returns correctly formatted product data with server-defined prices (price: 1.99, deluxePrice: 0.99). The API returns these values to the client, but business logic testing of whether client-submitted prices are accepted in basket operations could not be completed due to BasketItems endpoint failures. However, the product prices are clearly server-sourced and would need to be re-validated server-side on order creation (standard e-commerce practice).

485dab.risk_area: Business Logic + Authorization - IDOR on Baskets
485dab.evidence: GET /api/Baskets/{id} returns 500 errors. OWASP Juice Shop is known to have IDOR vulnerabilities. Could not test whether one user can access another user's basket without proper API contract. Requires source code review or browser-based testing to confirm.

007d3c.evidence: Confirmed horizontal IDOR: authenticated user can access any other user's profile data via /api/Users/{userId} endpoint. Working PoC demonstrates attacker accessing victim's email, role, and personal metadata without authorization.
